nodes.question: Can you explain how the induced blue water consumption at the country level was further disaggregated into watersheds?
nodes.answer: The induced blue water consumption at the country level was disaggregated into watersheds using the Water GAP 2.2 model. This involved distributing the total blue water consumption in watersheds to each country based on the area of the part corresponding to that country.
